SEARCH
Package com.saicone.types.parser

Interface EnumParser<T extends Enum<T>>

Type Parameters:
T - the type result of the function.
All Superinterfaces:
Function<Object,T>, TypeParser<T>
Functional Interface:
This is a functional interface and can therefore be used as the assignment target for a lambda expression or method reference.
@FunctionalInterface public interface EnumParser<T extends Enum<T>> extends TypeParser<T>
Represents a function that try to parse any type of object to enum type.
This parser is also compatible with enum ordinal, enum name and even other enum object by extracting ordinal value.
